```yaml
name: Rebuild Model Site on Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  rebuild-model-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests

      - name: Fetch model site deploy hook
        id: fetch-deploy-hook
        run: echo "::set-output name=hook::${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}"

      - name: Trigger Vercel rebuild
        run: |
          curl -X POST ${{ steps.fetch-deploy-hook.outputs.hook }}
```
